text.id: Papan dermaganya bunyi tiap gue injek. Dia pasti denger gue dari ujung sana. Tapi dia nggak nengok sampai gue berdiri persis di pinggir lingkaran lampu.
text.en: The planks creak with every step. She must hear me from the far end. But she doesn't turn until I'm standing right at the edge of the lamp's circle.

text.id: Lo telat setahun.
text.en: You're a year late.

text.id: Kapalnya Pak Karta berangkat tepat waktu. Gue yang telat.
text.en: Pak Karta's boat left on time. I didn't.

text.id: Pak Hendra cerita lewat radio. Dinda. Didit. Lo masuk dasbor gue pake nama kapal. Lo ke rumah Pak Karta.
text.en: Pak Hendra told me over the radio. Dinda. Didit. You got into my dashboard with a boat's name. You went to Pak Karta's house.

text.id: Gue nggak nyangka lo yang dateng. Gue ngetik "jam lima pagi" ke lo karena... nggak tahu. Karena cuma lo yang bakal ngerti angkanya.
text.en: I didn't think it would be you who came. I typed "five in the morning" to you because... I don't know. Because you're the only one who'd understand the number.

text.id: Ini saatnya. Setahun lalu, di tembok laut, gue tahu persis harus ngomong apa. Dan gue diem.
text.en: This is the moment. A year ago, on the seawall, I knew exactly what to say. And I said nothing.

text.id: Sekar nungguin jawaban. Lagi.
text.en: Sekar is waiting for an answer. Again.

text.id: "Maaf, Kar. Buat semuanya."
text.en: "I'm sorry, Kar. For all of it."

text.id: "Episode-episode lo bagus. Semuanya. Harusnya gue bilang dari dulu."
text.en: "Your episodes were good. All of them. I should have said so back then."

text.id: "Lo bilang gue bakal tahu harus mulai dari mana. Gue mulai."
text.en: "You said I'd know where to start. I started."

text.id: (Nggak usah jawab.)
text.en: (Don't answer.)

text.id: Setahun gue nungguin satu kata itu. Ternyata kedengerannya biasa aja.{w} ...Nggak. Bohong. Nggak biasa.
text.en: A year I waited for that one word. Turns out it sounds pretty ordinary.{w} ...No. That's a lie. It doesn't.

text.id: Semuanya? Episode tiga juga? Yang suaranya kayak direkam di dalem kulkas?
text.en: All of them? Episode three too? The one that sounds like it was recorded inside a fridge?

text.id: Episode tiga terutama.
text.en: Episode three especially.

text.id: Lo denger voice note-nya.{w} Gue rekam itu jam dua pagi, sambil mikir lo nggak bakal pernah denger.
text.en: You heard the voice note.{w} I recorded that at two in the morning, thinking you'd never hear it.

text.id: Tuh kan. Diem lagi.
text.en: See? Quiet again.

text.id: Nggak apa-apa, Ka. Lo dateng. Itu juga semacam ngomong.{w} Cuma bukan yang gue butuhin.
text.en: It's fine, Ka. You came. That's a kind of talking too.{w} Just not the kind I need.

text.id: Dia duduk di ujung dermaga, kaki ngegantung di atas air, kayak di tembok laut dulu. Gue duduk di sebelahnya. Kali ini nggak terlalu jauh dari pinggir.
text.en: She sits at the end of the jetty, legs hanging over the water, like on the seawall back then. I sit beside her. This time not so far from the edge.

text.id: Rekaman Pak Darmawan ada di sini. Satu jam. Dia nyebut nama, tanggal, nomor halaman. Halaman tiga puluh tujuh, Ka. Kajian yang mereka ajukan sama yang asli beda di situ.
text.en: Pak Darmawan's recording is in here. An hour. He names names, dates, page numbers. Page thirty-seven, Ka. That's where the review they filed and the real one differ.

text.id: Tapi nggak ada yang bakal percaya selama polisi mikir gue diculik. Mereka bakal ngambil ini sebagai "barang bukti", terus ini hilang. Kayak semua barang bukti lain di kota ini.
text.en: But nobody will believe it as long as the police think I was kidnapped. They'll take this as "evidence", and then it'll disappear. Like every other piece of evidence in this city.

text.id: Lo nyimpen foto tembok laut itu. Yang gue setengah kepotong.
text.en: You kept that photo from the seawall. The one where I'm half cut off.

text.id: Lo emang selalu setengah kepotong, Ka. Setengah di sini, setengah udah mau kabur.
text.en: You're always half cut off, Ka. Half here, half already leaving.

text.id: Pak Hendra muterin yang dari kapal. Senin malem.
text.en: Pak Hendra played me the one from the boat. Monday night.

text.id: Itu harusnya dikirim kalau gue nggak balik.{w} Gue balik, kok. Kebetulan lo juga.
text.en: That was only meant to be sent if I didn't come back.{w} I came back, though. So did you, as it happens.

text.id: Gue juga denger yang jam enam dua belas. Dua gelas kopi.
text.en: I heard the six twelve one too. Two cups of coffee.

text.id: Yang itu bukan buat siapa-siapa.{w} ...Kopinya gue minum dua-duanya. Gue nggak tidur sampai Senin.
text.en: That one wasn't for anyone.{w} ...I drank both coffees. I didn't sleep until Monday.

text.id: Ada satu angka lagi yang dari tadi muter di kepala lo. Enam dua belas. Dua gelas kopi. Menit dua belas. Satu HP jadul.
text.en: There's one more number that's been going round your head. Six twelve. Two cups of coffee. Minute twelve. One old phone.

text.id: "Kar. Nol enam dua belas. Itu bukan satu file, kan?"
text.en: "Kar. Zero six twelve. That isn't just one file, is it?"

text.id: (Biarin malam ini sederhana.)
text.en: (Let tonight stay simple.)

text.id: Malam itu kita nggak ngomong soal Didit lagi. Sepupu Pak Hendra masak ikan bakar. Sekar ketiduran duluan, alat rekamnya masih di genggaman.
text.en: We don't talk about Didit again that night. Pak Hendra's cousin grills fish. Sekar falls asleep first, the recorder still in her hand.
